# propagation mutation distance

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:propagationMutationDistance`](gmeow-propagationMutationDistance.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/propagationMutationDistance>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The number of transmission hops before a propagated deceptive claim mutates. Solver-layer computation ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:propagationMutationDistance`](gmeow-propagationMutationDistance.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a disinformation-campaign event to record how many propagation hops a claim survives before mutating — a solver metric over the [prov:wasDerivedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom) / [`gmeow:propagatesFrom`](gmeow-propagatesFrom.md) chain that helps locate the misinformation↔disinformation boundary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it as an authored fact (it is solver-derived, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid reading it as a per-node intent label — the originating-deceiver vs unwitting-dupe distinction is per-node ([`gmeow:roleDeceiver`](../individuals/gmeow-roleDeceiver.md) / [`gmeow:roleDupe`](../individuals/gmeow-roleDupe.md)), not a campaign-wide hop count.

### How to use

- Let the solver compute the [xsd:integer](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) distance from the propagation chain and write it onto the campaign event; keep per-node intent on [`gmeow:deceptiveIntentClaim`](gmeow-deceptiveIntentClaim.md) and roles rather than inferring it from this number.

### Examples

- ex:campaign [`gmeow:propagationMutationDistance`](gmeow-propagationMutationDistance.md) 3.
